methodology.roster_reconstruction: act_keys_by_rin/act_keys_by_agency rebuilt from rows where corroboration_rule IS NULL AND act_key IS NOT NULL -- faithful to the builder's own 'oracles built before corroboration runs' rule
methodology.act_index: output/usc-act-index-2026-08-22 via ActIndex.from_artifact + output/usc-source-credit-index-2026-08-02 via SourceCreditIndex.from_artifact
methodology.abstract_extraction: read directly from pinned edition XML (ABSTRACT element), same digest/byte-length pins as unified_agenda_editions.py; not exposed by the reader today

population_A.definition: earlier box names an act (act_key already resolved, OR stated_act_name, OR an initialism matched against the RIN/agency roster) and a later box -- anywhere after it, not just ordinal+-1 -- is a bare section/section-list with NO scheme, still authority_type=other/parse_status=failed

population_B.definition: rows typed other/failed (or act_relative/failed carrying stated_section) whose text contains a 2-6-capital initialism token
